messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Ingress gateway spike - 502/504 rate above threshold across edge proxies in us-west-2. 3xx -> 5xx ratio rising. sampling window 60s.

incident-bot: Summary metrics: p95 latency 420ms (+120%), 502 rate 18% (baseline 0.7%), 504 rate 3%. origin: apigw-edge-fanout pool.

sre_anna: ack — paging oncall. i'm looking at proxy pool metrics now.

oncall-bot: Paging: @sre_anna is oncall for incidents for the next 30m. @gateway-dave is on rotation.

platform-ben: I'm seeing a sudden fanout from a small subset of customers hitting a backend that times out. Logs show a flood of retries -> upstream overload. grep output: 
```
2026-03-15T19:01:02Z ERRO upstream timeout id=svc-xyz req=abcd ttl_ms=3000
2026-03-15T19:01:03Z ERRO connection reset by peer id=svc-xyz
```

gateway-dave: any recent deploys? I just checked deploy-bot — no gateway code deploys in last 2h. There was a config change to the L4 blackhole rule 19:07 UTC.

sre_anna: support-eve, can you confirm customer impact table? which tenants seeing errors?

support-eve: Support reports elevated errors for ~12 customers in us-west-2, mostly high-throughput integrations (webhooks). One enterprise customer (org-17) reporting timeouts in dashboard. No billing or data loss reported yet.

platform-ben: quick experiment: disabling aggressive retry and enabling host-level circuit breaker for svc-xyz reduces downstream pressure. Running command: 
```
redwoodctl routing update --service svc-xyz --circuit-breaker enable --max-conns 80
```

platform-ben: immediate effect: 502 rate dropped from 18% -> 9% in 30s, p95 fell 420ms -> 260ms.

gateway-dave: good. i'm going to flip regional fallback for edge proxies so traffic bypasses the overloaded backend when hits exceed threshold. policy change: 
```
edge-policy apply --region us-west-2 --fallback=regional-model-b
```

sre_anna: confirmed fallback applied. monitoring delta: 502 -> 6% and overall request success improving. still seeing tail errors from retries.

pm_jordan: do we need an outbound customer note? impact seems transient but some dashboards stale. We should prepare a short-informational blurb.

support-eve: please share templated blurb, i'll target affected accounts. need ETA for full mitigation.

platform-ben: action list so far: 1) enabled cb on svc-xyz 2) disabled client retries at edge 3) applied regional fallback 4) increased pool size for apigw-edge-fanout by +20% (manual scale).

platform-ben: scale command: 
```
infra scale --pool apigw-edge-fanout --add 6
```

sre_anna: i ran live tail on ingress logs and did a health check against svc-xyz:
```
$ curl -sS -D - https://svc-xyz.internal/health || true
HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Time-out
```
Indicates upstream still degraded. Might be transient overloaded worker nodes at svc-xyz.

gateway-dave: i'm going to temporarily stop fanout to that backend for non-critical routes and route them to q-standby. Doing a conservative route prune now.

sre_anna: doing post-change validation: p95 now 210ms, 502 3.4%. CPU on apigw-edge hosts normalized. Good signal.

pm_jordan: agree we should notify customers in affected list that we've mitigated and are monitoring; ETA for full recovery unknown until svc-xyz team fixes backend.

support-eve: drafting note: "We've observed elevated 502/504 errors for some customers in us-west-2 earlier today. Mitigation applied and traffic rerouted. No data loss. If you still see issues, contact support." ready to send on approval.

platform-ben: next step: engage svc-xyz owners (team-service) to investigate backend worker saturation and retry storm. @svc-xyz-owner please triage.

sre_anna: temporary mitigation timeline: 15min for current measures to stabilize, add runbook steps to incident doc. I'll capture logs and retention for postmortem.

gateway-dave: note — during troubleshooting we saw a spike in concurrent connections from a single customer IP range due to a misconfigured client-side retry backoff. Suggest we throttle at LB layer for that CIDR until they patch.

sre_anna: good call. applying 1m token bucket limiter for the offending CIDR: 
```
edge-qos apply --cidr 203.0.113.0/24 --rate 120r/m --burst 40
```

sre_anna: limiter applied. monitoring shows offending CIDR request rate down 70% and 502 errors dropping further.

oncall-bot: Handoff: @gateway-dave will take lead for next 25m. @sre_anna please file the incident and assign postmortem if elevated error still >1% in 1h.

gateway-dave: taking handoff. will keep monitoring and coordinate with svc-xyz owners. plan: keep circuit breaker and fallback for now, re-evaluate after 60m.

pm_jordan: thx team. PM note: escalate to account execs for org-17 (affected enterprise) with brief summary.

support-eve: sent initial customer notes to affected accounts. awaiting any replies.

sre_anna: summary (for post): root symptom: ingress 502/504 spike due to upstream svc-xyz overload + retry amplification from certain clients. Mitigations: circuit breaker, disable retries at edge, regional fallback, scale edge pool, apply CIDR rate limit. Current status: stable, 502 ~1.1% and trending down. Next steps: svc-xyz owner deep-dive, postmortem, runbook updates to include quick-fallback commands.

gateway-dave: logging final checkpoint in thread before monitoring-only. Will reopen if regression. :thumbsup:

support-eve: closing active customer escalations unless new reports come in.

pm_jordan: please add timeline and metric graphs to postmortem. thanks all."
